column1: A balanced melee fighter trained in sword and shield combat. Durable and dependable, ideal for players who enjoy frontline roles and absorbing damage.
column2: 攻守兼备的近战斗士，精通剑盾作战。坚韧可靠，适合喜欢坚守前线、承受伤害的玩家。

column1: A broken piece of Granite, rough-edged and stubbornly heavy.
column2: 一块破碎的花岗岩，边缘粗糙，分量重得出奇。

column1: A chain of strikes, once begun, was not to be interrupted by pity, recoil, or restraint, but carried through until resistance forgot how to stand.
column2: 连击一旦开始，便不可因怜悯、反冲或克制而中断，直至抵抗者忘却如何站立。

column1: A flawless glow is never forced. It is persuaded, cautiously, with expensive materials.
column2: 无瑕的光芒从不能强求，只能用昂贵材料小心地把它劝出来。

column1: A gem can be refined all the way to +10. Of course, the brighter it shines, the more fragile its structure becomes.
column2: 宝石最高可精炼至 +10。当然，光芒越盛，结构也会越脆弱。

column1: A gem infused with ancient essence. When embedded into an Artifact, it awakens hidden strength within its bearer.
column2: 一颗注入古老精华的宝石。嵌入神器后，会唤醒持有者体内潜藏的力量。

column1: A golden seal shines beside the name as a visible mark of creative victory. Rare fortune honors the craft of shaping SpiritVale through imagination.
column2: 一枚金色印章在名字旁闪耀，彰显创意上的成就。这份稀有殊荣，嘉奖以想象力塑造 SpiritVale 的创作。

column1: A good fighter watches the field. A great one knows when to retreat.
column2: 优秀的战士会观察战场，真正的高手则知道何时撤退。

column1: A heavy rite pulls enemies inward before the well answers with dissonance.
column2: 沉重仪式先将敌人向内拖拽，随后深井迸发失谐回响。

column1: A little coin, a careful hand, and now you can choose a better option.
column2: 一点金币，一双巧手，你就能重新选择更好的方案。

column1: A little Essence, a little nerve, and suddenly your gear can slay anything.
column2: 一点精华，一点胆量，装备转眼就能大杀四方。

column1: A little thread, a little glue, and suddenly everyone pretends this was intentional.
column2: 一点线，一点胶，转眼间人人都会假装这本来就是设计。

column1: A new hairstyle can solve many problems. Not all of them, but enough to justify the visit.
column2: 新发型能解决不少问题。虽非全部，但足够让你来这一趟。

column1: A quiet light, carried faithfully, was enough to steady the wounded and guide the lost.
column2: 一束由虔诚守护的静谧之光，便足以安定伤者、引领迷途者。

column1: A shimmering shield diverts part of incoming harm into mana.
column2: 闪耀护盾会将部分所受伤害转移至法力。

column1: A supporter helped lay the first stones of SpiritVale. The name carries a lasting weight of origin and noble recognition.
column2: 一名支持者帮助奠下 SpiritVale 最初的基石。名字铭刻着开创之初的分量与崇高认可。

column1: A true supporter became part of SpiritVale itself. The name carries wayfarer pride and belongs beside the world they helped raise.
column2: 一名真正的支持者成为 SpiritVale 本身的一部分。名字承载旅人的荣耀，也属于他们共同建立的世界。

column1: A word given, a spirit answered, and what the living lacked was supplied by covenant.
column2: 一言既出，灵体回应，生者所缺的一切便由契约补足。

column1: Across the land, you will find Waypoints bound to other places. Discover them, and your Waystone will remember their locations.
column2: 各地都有与不同地点相连的传送点。发现它们后，传送石便会记住其位置。

column1: Aim was not given for pride, but so that no needed strike be wasted and no danger mistaken for another.
column2: 瞄准并非为骄傲而赐，而是为了不浪费任何必要的一击，也不将危险错认成他物。

column1: All things hum with resonance. I only help them find their note.
column2: 万物皆因共鸣而低吟，我只帮它们找准音调。

column1: Arcane power strengthens spells and speeds casting at a heavier mana cost.
column2: 奥术力量强化法术并加快施法，但会消耗更多法力。

column1: Arcane seams draw mana like frost pulling breath from air.
column2: 奥术缝线牵引法力，如同寒霜从空气中抽走呼吸。

column1: Arcanum Scroll of Twist Of Fate
Are you sure you want to quit the game?
Artifacts hold power. Gems teach them memory.
column2: 神器承载力量，宝石则赋予它们记忆。

column1: Ascension is permitted. Wisdom is optional, apparently.
column2: 准许攀升。至于智慧，看来并非必需。

column1: Before oath and kingdom, before ruin and remembrance, all forces mingled in one body.
column2: 在誓约与王国之前，在毁灭与记忆之前，一切力量曾交融于同一具躯体。

column1: Before oath and kingdom, before ruin and remembrance, the first elements were set in balance.
column2: 在誓约与王国之前，在毁灭与记忆之前，最初的元素已归于平衡。

column1: Before the names of spells were written, Vitae moved through the world as a current unseen yet generous.
column2: 在法术之名被写下以前，维泰便如无形而慷慨的洪流，行遍世间。

column1: Before the roads were named, Umbra marked the first ground taken by strength.
column2: 在道路尚未得名之前，翁布拉已标下力量夺取的第一片土地。

column1: Before the roads were named, Vitae blessed the first step into the unmade world.
column2: 在道路尚未得名之前，维泰赐福了迈向未塑世界的第一步。

column1: Before the war divided memory, Vitae set the first art into mortal hands as a gift of ordered wonder.
column2: 在战争割裂记忆之前，维泰将最初的法术置于凡人手中，作为秩序奇迹的馈赠。

column1: Before the world was divided into rival truths, Vitae remembered a greater wholeness in which every element and living force belonged to one weave.
column2: 在世界被割裂成彼此对立的真理之前，维泰记得一种更宏大的完整：一切元素与生命之力都属于同一幅织锦。

column1: Beware the Bunny. This is not a joke. The last person laughed too.
column2: 当心那只兔子。这不是玩笑——上一个发笑的人也曾这么以为。

column1: Bind an ally with guardian magic, granting Vitality and Regeneration through a shared bond.
column2: 以守护魔法绑定一名盟友，通过共享羁绊赋予活力与再生。

column1: Blue script echoes every cast, leaving spare mana humming in its wake.
column2: 蓝色文字回响着每一次施法，余波中仍有备用法力低鸣。

column1: Bond and burden alike were made to endure beyond their first breath, held fast by will so that no promise would fade simply because time demanded it.
column2: 羁绊与重负皆应超越最初一息而延续，由意志牢牢维系，使任何承诺都不因时光逼迫而褪色。

column1: Bone, breath, and rot held records the living feared, each fragment a memory waiting to be commanded.
column2: 骨骸、气息与腐朽保存着生者畏惧的记录，每块碎片都是等待号令的记忆。

column1: Bound magic always leaves a thread. I simply know where to pull.
column2: 绑定的魔法总会留下一根线头，我只知道该拉哪一根。

column1: Bring a Spire Compass, or bring an excellent excuse. The Spire accepts only one of those.
column2: 要么带来尖塔指南针，要么想个绝妙的借口。可惜尖塔只接受其中一种。

column1: Bring allies if you trust them. Bring confidence if you trust yourself.
column2: 信得过队友就带上他们，信得过自己就带上自信。

column1: Bring me enough junk, and I'll make it a design choice.
column2: 废料带得够多，我就能把它变成一种设计风格。

column1: Bring me the strange bits. I'll make them socially acceptable.
column2: 把那些奇怪零件带来，我会让它们变得适合穿出门。

column1: Bring me what you recover from the Spire, and I may craft something worthy of your ascent.
column2: 把你从尖塔中寻回的东西交给我，我或许能打造出配得上这趟攀升的物品。

column1: Burning or Stun triggers Combustion. Fire Pillar gains more instances, and Meteor becomes Meteor Storm.
column2: 燃烧或眩晕会触发燃爆。火柱的生效次数增加，陨星则变为陨星风暴。

column1: By Suphara's hammer, fresh gear! Bring me weapons, armor, artifacts, and the right refining materials, and I can make them stronger.
column2: 以苏帕拉之锤起誓，新装备！把武器、护甲、神器和对应的精炼材料带来，我能让它们变得更强。

column1: Calibrated mana splits along the edge, breaking into elemental force.
column2: 校准后的法力沿刃缘分流，迸裂成元素力量。

column1: Cards can bind powerful magic into gear. I can loosen that bond and remove them for a bit of coin.
column2: 卡牌能将强大魔法绑定到装备上。花一点金币，我可以解除绑定并取出卡牌。

column1: Cards cling tightly once bound. Fortunately, I am very persuasive.
column2: 卡牌一旦绑定就会死死黏住。好在我很会“劝”它们松手。

column1: Change can be scary, but not when it's this fabulous.
column2: 改变或许吓人，但变得这么惊艳就另当别论了。

column1: Chaos doesn't make mistakes. It makes "surprises."
column2: 混沌不会犯错，只会制造“惊喜”。

column1: Chaos, Destruction, Flow, Growth, Rebirth... each Essence changes gear in its own strange way. I'm just here to facilitate the process, for better or worse.
column2: 混沌、破坏、流转、成长、重生……每种精华都会以独特而古怪的方式改变装备。我只负责促成这个过程，结果是好是坏可不归我管。

column1: Choose your path carefully. The strength you pursue will shape the way you fight.
column2: 谨慎选择道路。你所追求的力量，将塑造你的战斗方式。

column1: Collapse umbral energy across a wide area, marking enemies so incoming attacks hit harder.
column2: 使幽影能量在大范围内坍缩，标记敌人，使后续攻击造成更多伤害。

column1: Come here when your body is broken, your mana is empty, or your status effects have become unbearable.
column2: 当你伤痕累累、法力耗尽，或状态效果已经难以忍受时，就来找我。

column1: Come to return, or to begin again?
column2: 是来传送，还是想重新开始？

column1: Compels inflicted targets to focus their attention on you. Increases Threat generation.
column2: 迫使受影响的目标集中攻击你，并提高仇恨值。

column1: Created by Professor Elsi. Take slow steady sips to renew one's mana.
column2: 由教授 Elsi 制作。小口缓缓饮用，可恢复自身法力。

column1: Distance was not made for fear, but for judgment, so that the wise might end ruin before it crossed the threshold.
column2: 距离并非因恐惧而生，而是为了判断，让智者能在毁灭越过门槛前将其终结。

column1: Divine grace restores life and mana with exceptional force.
column2: 神圣恩典会强效恢复生命与法力。

column1: Divine power improves healing and lets blessings linger at a higher mana cost.
column2: 神圣力量提升治疗效果，并延长祝福持续时间，但会消耗更多法力。

column1: Do not worry. Most adventurers arrive here looking worse.
column2: 别担心，大多数冒险者来时比你还狼狈。

column1: Don't blame me if the hammer says no. I only sell rocks.
column2: 要是锻锤不答应，可别怪我。我只负责卖石头。

column1: Don't call it junk. Call it aggressively unfinished fashion.
column2: 别叫它废料，叫它“极具进取心的未完成时装”。

column1: Early faith stood behind SpiritVale before the road was fully built. Quiet pride and visible support remain carried in the name.
column2: 在 SpiritVale 的道路尚未铺就时，早期支持者便已坚定相伴。名字承载着低调的自豪，也彰显长久的支持。

column1: Earthen protection hardens the user and can answer incoming blows with Stun.
column2: 大地防护会强化使用者；受到攻击时，有概率使攻击者眩晕。

column1: Emit a gentle divine aura, increasing Vitality and HP recovery for nearby allies.
column2: 散发温和的神圣光环，提高附近盟友的活力与生命值恢复。

column1: Endurance was not given so they might crush others, but so they would not yield when others depended on them.
column2: 坚韧并非为碾压他人而赐，而是为了在他人依赖他们时绝不退让。

column1: Enter a precise killing stance, increasing critical chance and Critical Damage.
column2: 进入精准杀戮姿态，提高暴击率与暴击伤害。

column1: Every gem has a voice, and some are simply very dramatic.
column2: 每颗宝石都有自己的声音，有些就是格外爱演。

column1: Every great merchant started somewhere. Most of them started cheaper than you.
column2: 每位大商人都有起点，只是多数人的起价都比你低。

column1: Every item can be refined all the way to +10. Naturally, the higher it goes, the more likely the forge will make you pay for it.
column2: 每件物品最高都能精炼至 +10。当然，等级越高，熔炉越可能让你付出代价。

column1: Every item has potential, but not an endless amount. Spend only what you can afford.
column2: 每件物品都有潜能，但并非取之不尽。只投入你承受得起的代价。

column1: Every match teaches something, even the ones you lose.
column2: 每场对战都能教会你一些东西，输掉的也不例外。

column1: Every wound became a drumbeat, every swing a demand that the body spend itself before doubt could speak.
column2: 每一道伤口都化作鼓点，每一次挥击都催促身体在疑虑开口前燃尽自身。

column1: Extraction is mercy; refinement, a form of prayer.
column2: 萃取是一种慈悲，精炼则是一种祈祷。

column1: Fashion is temporary. Monster goo stains are forever.
column2: 潮流会过时，怪物黏液留下的污渍可不会。

column1: Fate was not a chain, but a pattern, and every bolt was a strand returned to its proper crossing.
column2: 命运并非锁链，而是一幅纹样；每一道飞弹，都是归回正确交点的丝线。

column1: Feeling bold, or just bored? Either way, let's make it work.
column2: 是想大胆一回，还是单纯无聊？无论如何，都来换个造型吧。

column1: Field bosses may appear when you least want company.
column2: 野外首领总会在你最不想有人作伴时出现。

column1: Fight clean, fight smart, and try not to embarrass yourself.
column2: 堂堂正正地打，聪明地打，也尽量别让自己丢脸。

column1: Filled to the brim with mana crystals. Increases the user's mana reserves.
column2: 装满了法力水晶。提高使用者的法力储量。

column1: Find a Waypoint, and the path back becomes easier.
column2: 发现一处传送点，回程就会更加轻松。

column1: Fire warmed, water yielded, wind carried, and earth endured, each giving shape without dominion.
column2: 火焰供暖，流水顺势，疾风承载，大地坚忍；各自塑造万物，却不彼此支配。

column1: Fire was not given to warm or purify, but to leave behind a lesson even ash would remember.
column2: 火焰并非为温暖或净化而赐，而是为了留下连灰烬都不会遗忘的教训。

column1: First rule of sailing: respect the water. Second rule: hold on when I say hold on.
column2: 航海第一条：敬畏大海。第二条：我喊抓紧时，就给我抓紧。

column1: Flame shields the user and can answer incoming blows with Burning.
column2: 火焰保护使用者；受到攻击时，有概率灼烧攻击者。

column1: Flame, frost, stone, and storm were not taught as weapons alone, but as languages through which the world might be understood without being broken.
column2: 烈焰、寒霜、岩石与风暴不只被教作武器，更是让人不必毁坏世界便能理解它的语言。

column1: Flame, frost, storm, and stone were gathered not as rivals, but as guardians circling one patient will.
column2: 烈焰、寒霜、风暴与岩石汇聚一处，并非彼此争斗，而是环绕同一股沉着意志的守护者。

column1: For a foe ended in silence is worth more than glory that warns him first. - Codex Umbra
column2: 因为在寂静中终结敌人，胜过以荣光事先示警。——翁布拉法典

column1: For a secret preserved in darkness endures longer than a truth shouted into the wind. - Codex Umbra
column2: 因为保存在黑暗中的秘密，比向风中呼喊的真理更为长久。——翁布拉法典

column1: For an oath kept beneath the sun is worth more than victory won without a name. - Codex Vitae
column2: 因为阳光下恪守的誓言，胜过无名换来的胜利。——维泰法典

column1: For blessed is the bullet that ends danger before chaos reaches the innocent. - Codex Vitae
column2: 因为能在混乱波及无辜者之前终结危险的子弹，必蒙祝福。——维泰法典

column1: For blessed is the eye that does not wander, and holier still the will that follows it without doubt. - Codex Vitae
column2: 因为不曾游移的目光必蒙祝福，而毫不犹疑地追随它的意志更为神圣。——维泰法典

column1: For blessed is the heart that cannot be thrown, shaken, or turned against itself. - Codex Vitae
column2: 因为不被击退、不受动摇、亦不反噬自身的心灵，必蒙祝福。——维泰法典

column1: For blessed is the soul that moves like shadow, felt in passing and never held. - Codex Umbra
column2: 因为如暗影般移动的灵魂必蒙祝福：掠过时可被感知，却永远无法被握住。——翁布拉法典

column1: For blessed is the soul that moves like wind, touching many lives without claiming any for its own. - Codex Vitae
column2: 因为如风般移动的灵魂必蒙祝福：触及无数生命，却不将任何一个据为己有。——维泰法典

column1: For control is holiest not when it restrains the gift, but when it guides it flawlessly where it is needed most. - Codex Vitae
column2: 因为掌控最神圣之处，不在于束缚天赋，而在于将它分毫不差地引向最需要之地。——维泰法典

column1: For destiny is brightest when power is woven without tearing the world that bears it. - Codex Vitae
column2: 因为力量被编织而不撕裂承载它的世界时，命运最为明亮。——维泰法典

column1: For eternity is not the triumph of one force, but the concord of all that was meant to endure together. - Codex Vitae
column2: 因为永恒并非一种力量的凯旋，而是所有注定共存之物的和鸣。——维泰法典

column1: For holiness is not proven by spectacle, but by the grace that remains when all else is shaken. - Codex Vitae
column2: 因为圣洁不由壮观之举证明，而见于万物动摇之后依然留存的恩典。——维泰法典

column1: For life is holiest when it returns where suffering once believed itself eternal. - Codex Vitae
column2: 因为生命最神圣之时，便是它重返那片曾被苦难自认永恒的土地。——维泰法典

column1: For life sometimes returns only after the old darkness has been turned to ash. - Codex Vitae
column2: 因为有时，唯有陈旧的黑暗化为灰烬，生命才会归来。——维泰法典

column1: For magic is purest when it leaves the world more whole than it found it. - Codex Vitae
column2: 因为魔法最纯粹之时，是它让世界比施展之前更加完整。——维泰法典

column1: For magic is truest when it teaches the world that nothing struck is ever unchanged again. - Codex Umbra
column2: 因为魔法最真实之时，便是它让世界明白：凡被击中者，再也无法恢复如初。——翁布拉法典

column1: For mercy is not always the healing hand; sometimes it is the shield that ensures the wound is never made. - Codex Vitae
column2: 因为慈悲不总是治愈之手；有时，它是让伤口永不出现的盾。——维泰法典

column1: For mercy is not weakened by judgment when judgment clears the path for life. - Codex Vitae
column2: 因为当审判为生命扫清道路时，慈悲不会因此减损。——维泰法典

column1: For mercy is the silence after fury has taken all it was owed. - Codex Umbra
column2: 因为狂怒讨尽一切血债后的寂静，便是仁慈。——翁布拉法典

column1: For nothing buried is truly lost to the one who can hear it answer. - Codex Umbra
column2: 对于能听见埋藏之物回应的人而言，没有什么会真正遗失。——翁布拉法典

column1: For power belongs not to the untouched, but to the one who survives the blow and returns it greater. - Codex Umbra
column2: 因为力量不属于毫发无伤者，而属于承受一击后以更强之势奉还的人。——翁布拉法典

column1: For power is most honest when it cuts, consumes, and leaves no doubt who carried the fire. - Codex Umbra
column2: 因为力量最坦诚之时，便是它斩裂、吞噬，并让人再无疑问是谁携火而来。——翁布拉法典

column1: For power is purest when it is taken back from death before the grave can close. - Codex Umbra
column2: 因为在坟墓合拢之前从死亡手中夺回的力量，最为纯粹。——翁布拉法典

column1: For power is the truest mercy, and blessed is the hand that lets nothing die unused. - Codex Umbra
column2: 因为力量才是最真实的仁慈，而不让任何事物无用而死的手必蒙祝福。——翁布拉法典

column1: For sacred is the breath that is shared, and holier still the hand that preserves it. - Codex Vitae
column2: 因为与人共享的气息堪称神圣，而守护这气息的手更为圣洁。——维泰法典

column1: For sacred is the mark that survives resistance, and stronger still the one written in blood. - Codex Umbra
column2: 因为经受抵抗仍不磨灭的印记堪称神圣，而以鲜血写下者更为强大。——翁布拉法典

column1: For sacred is the path that is opened for others, and brighter still the one who leaves it behind. - Codex Vitae
column2: 因为为他人开辟的道路堪称神圣，而留下这条道路的人更为光明。——维泰法典

column1: For the highest art is not to borrow power safely, but to speak the burning language of the stars and remain standing when they reply. - Codex Umbra
column2: 因为至高法术并非安然借用力量，而是说出群星燃烧的语言，并在它们回应时依然屹立。——翁布拉法典

column1: For the highest strength is not to escape the blow, but to make the blow regret its making. - Codex Umbra
column2: 因为至高的力量不在于躲开一击，而在于让这一击后悔降临。——翁布拉法典

column1: For the holiest defense is the radiance that protects even while it strikes. - Codex Vitae
column2: 因为最神圣的防御，是在出击之时仍施以庇护的光辉。——维泰法典

column1: For the oldest magic was never meant to dominate creation, but to speak with it. - Codex Vitae
column2: 因为最古老的魔法从来不是为了支配造物，而是为了与之交谈。——维泰法典

column1: For the purest vessel is not the one that hoards the light, but the one through which it continues. - Codex Vitae
column2: 因为最纯粹的容器并非囤积光明之物，而是让光明得以延续之物。——维泰法典

column1: For the strongest shot is not the one that is witnessed, but the one that is only understood after it lands. - Codex Umbra
column2: 因为最强的一击并非为人亲眼所见，而是命中之后才被领会。——翁布拉法典

column1: For the strongest ward is not the light that shines outward, but the void that permits nothing in. - Codex Umbra
column2: 因为最强的防护并非向外照耀的光，而是不容任何事物进入的虚空。——翁布拉法典

column1: For the surest art is the one remembered only after it has disappeared. - Codex Umbra
column2: 因为最可靠的技艺，只会在消失之后才被记起。——翁布拉法典

column1: For the surest hand is born first from the farthest sight. - Codex Vitae
column2: 因为最稳健的手，首先源于最深远的目光。——维泰法典

column1: For the surest victory is the one that leaves no space between impact and the will behind it. - Codex Umbra
column2: 因为最稳操胜券的胜利，不容冲击与驱使它的意志之间留下半分间隙。——翁布拉法典

column1: For the truest heart is not the one that never bleeds, but the one that refuses to break. - Codex Vitae
column2: 因为最真挚的心并非从不流血，而是拒绝破碎。——维泰法典

column1: For the truest oath is not the one spoken once, but the one that refuses to die. - Codex Umbra
column2: 因为最真实的誓言并非一时之言，而是拒绝消亡的誓言。——翁布拉法典

column1: For the wind obeys most faithfully when it is given a storm to remember. - Codex Umbra
column2: 因为当风被赐予一场值得铭记的风暴时，它最为忠顺。——翁布拉法典

column1: For the world is not preserved by purity alone, but by the will to bind what others fear to touch. - Codex Umbra
column2: 因为守护世界不能只靠纯净，更要有将众人畏于触碰之物收束一体的意志。——翁布拉法典

column1: For the world is strongest where every element keeps its place and protects the whole. - Codex Vitae
column2: 因为当每种元素各守其位、共同护佑整体时，世界最为强大。——维泰法典

column1: For the world was first made whole by harmony, and only later broken by will. - Codex Vitae
column2: 因为世界最初因和谐而完整，后来才被意志打破。——维泰法典

column1: For truth is not found in grace alone, but in the pact that delivers what faith only promises. - Codex Umbra
column2: 因为真理不只存在于恩典之中，也存在于将信仰的许诺化为现实的契约之中。——翁布拉法典

column1: For what is frozen is not gone, but held until power decides its thaw. - Codex Umbra
column2: 因为被冻结之物并未消失，只是被禁锢，直至力量决定何时解冻。——翁布拉法典

column1: Forty-eight hours. Make it count, or at least make it awkward for passersby.
column2: 四十八小时。好好利用，至少也要让路过的人感到尴尬。

column1: Free as part of a promotion at Finkle Winkle Ice Cream Shop. Say you're giving out ice cream. How about you go there too?
column2: Finkle Winkle 冰淇淋店促销期间免费赠送。听说他们正在发放冰淇淋，你也去看看吧？

column1: Gems remember more than they show. Bring me a gem and Lunaris Shards, and I can help awaken what sleeps within.
column2: 宝石铭记的远比显露的更多。带来一颗宝石和露娜里斯碎片，我能帮你唤醒其中沉睡的力量。

column1: Gives auto attacks a chance to strike additional times.
column2: 普通攻击有概率额外攻击数次。

column1: Good gear takes heat. Great gear survives it.
column2: 好装备经得起高温，极品装备熬得过烈火。

column1: Grace was not fragile kindness, but a force that named corruption, banished it, and carried mercy with a blade of light.
column2: 恩典并非脆弱的善意，而是一股指认并放逐腐化、以光之刃承载慈悲的力量。

column1: Grants the user Vitality and Regeneration.
column2: 赋予使用者活力与再生。

column1: Greatly increases all stats, Move Speed, and damage reduction. Grants Game Master Cloaking and Resurrection.
column2: 大幅提高所有属性、移动速度与伤害减免。获得管理员隐匿与复活术。

column1: Hair, face, colors, style... most things can be changed. Your name, however, is staying exactly where it is.
column2: 发型、脸型、颜色、风格……大多都能改。不过你的名字可改不了。

column1: Healing, swiftness, strength, and blessing were not separate gifts, but threads drawn together in harmony so that none would exalt itself above the rest.
column2: 治疗、迅捷、力量与祝福并非彼此独立的馈赠，而是和谐交织的丝线，谁也不凌驾于其余之上。

column1: Health, mana, curses, blessings... I clean the whole slate.
column2: 生命、法力、诅咒、祝福……我会把所有状态一并处理干净。

column1: Holy Light returns mana when its grace is consumed.
column2: 圣光的恩典被消耗时会返还法力。

column1: Holy magic strengthens and Holy Light reaches farther at a greater mana cost.
column2: 神圣魔法得到强化，圣光的作用距离更远，但会消耗更多法力。

column1: Holy, shadow, poison, and death were not enemies then, but truths awaiting a stronger hand.
column2: 彼时，神圣、暗影、剧毒与死亡并非仇敌，而是等待强者驾驭的真理。

column1: I also shape what the Spire leaves behind. Memory, resonance, nightmare... all useful materials, if handled correctly.
column2: 我也会加工尖塔留下的东西。记忆、共鸣、梦魇……只要处理得当，都是有用的材料。

column1: I can change your look, not your name. Some mistakes are beyond my scissors.
column2: 我能改你的外表，改不了你的名字。有些错误连剪刀也无能为力。

column1: I can craft with nightmare, yes. No, you should not ask why.
column2: 没错，我能用梦魇制作物品。不，你最好别问原因。

column1: I can restore your health and mana completely, and cleanse every effect clinging to you.
column2: 我能完全恢复你的生命与法力，并清除附着在你身上的所有效果。

column1: I keep watch over special experience events. Speak with me, and I'll tell you whether bonus experience is active.
column2: 我负责关注特殊经验活动。和我交谈，就能知道当前是否有额外经验加成。

column1: I make fashion out of things most people refuse to touch. You're welcome.
column2: 我把多数人碰都不愿碰的东西做成时装。不用谢。

column1: I manage vending stalls for adventurers who want to sell items while they are away.
column2: 我负责管理售货摊位，方便冒险者离开时继续出售物品。

column1: I manage your personal storage, so you can deposit items and withdraw them later on your other characters.
column2: 我负责管理你的个人仓库。存入的物品之后也能由你的其他角色取出。

column1: I see you brought monster parts. Brave choice, but the smell is always questionable.
column2: 看来你带了怪物部件。选择很勇敢，气味就不好说了。

column1: I sell what the blacksmith uses to gamble with. You're just funding his habit.
column2: 我卖的是铁匠拿来赌运气的东西，而你只是在给他的嗜好出钱。

column1: I separate what others swear was permanent.
column2: 别人信誓旦旦说永远拆不掉的东西，我能拆开。

column1: I used to be an adventurer like you... until that cursed Vorpal Hare.
column2: 我也曾是和你一样的冒险者……直到遇上那只该死的斩首野兔。

column1: I've seen vendors stand here for 48 hours and sell nothing. Inspiring.
column2: 我见过商贩在这里站满 48 小时，一件也没卖出去。真励志。

column1: Ice was not absence, but dominion, a silence strong enough to keep motion, breath, and terror exactly where they stood.
column2: 寒冰并非虚无，而是支配，是一种足以将动作、呼吸与恐惧尽数定在原处的寂静。

column1: If an upgrade fails, the item drops by one level. I call that "character building."
column2: 强化失败时，物品会降低一级。我管这叫“磨炼品格”。

column1: If it's weird, sticky, or sharp, I can probably turn it into a hat.
column2: 只要够怪、够黏或够尖，我多半都能把它做成帽子。

column1: If refinement fails, the gem drops by one level. This is called balance, or tragedy, depending on who paid for it.
column2: 精炼失败时，宝石会降低一级。这叫平衡；如果材料是你买的，也可以叫悲剧。

column1: If the echoes begin speaking in your voice, descend immediately.
column2: 若回声开始用你的声音说话，立刻下塔。

column1: If the gem brightens, thank the resonance. If it fails, perhaps you shouldn't keep hitting it.
column2: 宝石变亮了，就感谢共鸣；失败了，也许你不该再敲它。

column1: If the result is perfect, credit me. If not, blame the Essence.
column2: 结果完美就记我一功；不完美就怪精华。

column1: If you hear strange noises from the woods, congratulations. The woods heard you first.
column2: 如果听见林中传来怪声，恭喜你——森林先听见了你。

column1: If you're finding it tough out there, maybe try refining your gear.
column2: 如果在野外吃不消，或许该精炼一下装备。

column1: If you're ready, step in. If not, train until you are.
column2: 准备好了就进场；还没准备好，就练到准备好为止。

column1: If your own path ever feels wrong, return to me. I can reset your attributes and skills, so you may begin again.
column2: 若觉得自己走错了路，就回来找我。我能重置你的属性与技能，让你重新开始。

column1: If your path feels wrong, I can help you walk another.
column2: 若觉得走错了路，我可以帮你改走另一条。

column1: Imbue your attacks with the Earth element.
Imbue your attacks with the Fire element.
Imbue your attacks with the Poison element.
Imbue your attacks with the Water element.
Imbue your attacks with the Wind element.
Impact was not a cost to be feared, but the law by which weakness was driven out and resolve made real.
column2: 冲击并非应当畏惧的代价，而是驱逐软弱、将决心化为现实的法则。

column1: In the first calm after ruin, Umbra taught the wise to mark instead of mourn.
column2: 在毁灭后的初次宁静中，翁布拉教导智者留下烙印，而非沉湎哀悼。

column1: In the first calm after ruin, Vitae taught the wise to weave instead of wound.
column2: 在毁灭后的初次宁静中，维泰教导智者编织，而非伤害。

column1: Increases maximum HP, Vitality, and Healing Received.
column2: 提高最大生命值、活力与受到的治疗效果。

column1: Increases the damage dealt by your auto attacks.
column2: 提高普通攻击造成的伤害。

column1: Jewelcrafting is patience, pressure, and pretending the cracking sound was expected.
column2: 珠宝加工靠的是耐心、压力，以及假装那声裂响本就在预料之中。

column1: Judgment was not anger, nor was the blade raised for conquest, but to make a road where fear had gathered.
column2: 审判并非愤怒，举起刀锋也不是为了征服，而是为了在恐惧聚集之处开辟道路。

column1: Keep moving forward. Every battle should teach you something about the path ahead.
column2: 继续前进。每场战斗都应让你更了解前方的道路。

column1: Let each lesson settle before you reach for the next. Mastery is built in layers.
column2: 先让每一课沉淀，再迎接下一课。精通需要层层积累。

column1: Let the vow be spoken where all may hear, for truth does not fear witness.
column2: 让誓言在众人皆可听见之处宣告，因为真理从不畏惧见证。

column1: Let the work be done where none may hear, for necessity does not beg witness.
column2: 让行动在无人听闻之处完成，因为必要之举不乞求见证。

column1: Lightning was not a warning, but a command, and thunder the measure by which hesitation was shattered.
column2: 闪电并非警告，而是号令；雷鸣则是粉碎迟疑的尺度。

column1: Listen closely... the stone will tell you when it's ready.
column2: 仔细听……宝石准备好时会告诉你。

column1: Listen to what your experience has shown you. Growth is built from more than victory.
column2: 听从经验带来的启示。成长不只建立在胜利之上。

column1: Location, location, location. This one's available.
column2: 位置、位置，还是位置。这个摊位正空着。

column1: Long before open sanctums and sung prayers, Umbra kept wisdom in wells no eye could sound.
column2: 早在圣所开放、祷歌传唱之前，翁布拉便将智慧藏于目光无法探底的深井。

column1: Looking for a real test? I manage arena matches for adventurers who want to fight other adventurers.
column2: 想接受真正的考验？我负责为想与其他冒险者交手的人安排竞技场对战。

column1: Looking to cross the water? I sail from Wayfarer's Landing to Stormreef Isle whenever you're ready.
column2: 想渡海？准备好后，我随时可以从旅人港启航前往风暴礁岛。

column1: Lunar darkness coats the curve, drinking blood and mana together.
column2: 月色的黑暗覆上弯刃，同时啜饮鲜血与法力。

column1: Lunaris is gentle enough to keep the gem whole, and powerful enough to bring it to life.
column2: 露娜里斯足够温和，能让宝石保持完整；也足够强大，能赋予它生机。

column1: Mana channels glimmer across a polished blue shell.
column2: 法力脉络在抛光的蓝色甲壳上微微闪烁。

column1: Marked terrain sketches teach traps to pull prey into worse decisions.
column2: 标记清晰的地形图教会陷阱诱使猎物踏入更危险的境地。

column1: Mastery over Earth lets you assume this avatar state, increasing Earth damage while making you more resistant to attacks.
column2: 精通大地之力后，可进入岩石化身状态，提高大地属性伤害，并增强自身抗击能力。

column1: Mastery over Fire lets you assume this avatar state, increasing Fire damage and Healing Received while igniting those who dare attack you.
column2: 精通火焰之力后，可进入火焰化身状态，提高火属性伤害与受到的治疗效果，并点燃攻击你的敌人。

column1: Mastery over Water lets you assume this avatar state, increasing Water damage and MP Regen while freezing those who dare attack you.
column2: 精通水流之力后，可进入冰霜化身状态，提高水属性伤害与法力恢复，并冻结攻击你的敌人。

column1: Mastery over Wind lets you assume this avatar state, increasing Move Speed while discharging a blast of lightning at those who dare attack you.
column2: 精通疾风之力后，可进入风暴化身状态，提高移动速度，并以闪电轰击攻击你的敌人。

column1: Memory Fragments, Resonance Cores, Umbral Fragments... the Spire breaks many things into useful pieces.
column2: 记忆碎片、共鸣核心、幽影碎片……尖塔总能把许多东西碾成有用的零件。

column1: Mira keeps things simple: you bring the items, I keep them safe.
column2: 米拉的规矩很简单：你把物品带来，我替你妥善保管。

column1: Monster bones? Plant goo? Weird little claws? Yes, yes, and absolutely yes.
column2: 怪物骨头？植物黏液？奇怪的小爪子？要、要，当然要。
大自然留下的恶心边角料？那可是我的专长。

column1: Need a new look? I can guide you to the styling mirror and help reshape your appearance.
column2: 想换个新形象？我可以带你到造型镜前，帮你重新设计外观。

column1: Need refining materials? I've got Shards and Chunks for weapons, armor, and artifacts.
column2: 要精炼材料？武器、护甲和神器所需的碎片与材料块，我这里都有。

column1: Nevaris is bound to your Waystone now. Let it be your anchor.
column2: 内瓦里斯现已与你的传送石绑定。让它成为你的锚点。

column1: Nevaris welcomes all adventurers. The wilderness has not agreed to this policy.
column2: 内瓦里斯欢迎所有冒险家。荒野还没有同意这一政策。

column1: New adventurers: running away is a valid strategy if you survive long enough to use it.
column2: 新手冒险者须知：只要你能活到逃跑那一刻，逃跑就是有效的战术。

column1: No lost luggage, no mystery fees, no questions about why you need six identical hats.
column2: 不丢行李，不收神秘费用，也不过问你为何需要六顶一模一样的帽子。

column1: No, I am not a maid. I just happen to be very good at keeping everyone's belongings in perfect order.
column2: 不，我不是女仆，只是恰好很擅长把大家的物品整理得井井有条。

column1: Not to deny the wound, but to cover it in living mercy until pain forgot its name.
column2: 并非为了否认伤口，而是以鲜活的慈悲将其覆盖，直至痛苦忘却自己的名字。

column1: Not to deny the wound, but to keep its strength from fading into silence and dirt.
column2: 并非为了否认伤口，而是为了不让其中的力量消逝于寂静与尘土。

column1: Nothing says fresh start like pretending this was always your style.
column2: 没有什么比假装这一直都是你的风格，更像是“重新开始”了。

column1: One adventurer's junk is my next masterpiece.
column2: 冒险者眼中的废料，就是我的下一件杰作。

column1: One upgrade away from greatness... or regret. I supply both.
column2: 离巅峰只差一次强化……离后悔也一样。两种结果我都供应。

column1: Pay the stall fee, choose a shop name, and your vending spot will open for other adventurers to browse.
column2: 支付摊位费并选好店名，你的摊位就会开放，供其他冒险者选购。

column1: Please open the Steam client and restart the game!
column2: 请打开 Steam 客户端并重新启动游戏！

column1: Please update to the latest version
Poison courses through the target, disrupting mana recovery and worsening as it builds.
column2: 毒素在目标体内蔓延，干扰法力恢复，并随层数增加而加剧。

column1: Power echoes differently up there. Try not to echo back.
column2: 力量在上面会产生不同的回响。尽量别让自己也变成回声。

column1: Power is easy. Self-control is the expensive part.
column2: 力量来得容易，克制自己才最昂贵。

column1: Power was not given to soothe the wound, but to ensure that every wound remembered.
column2: 力量并非为抚平伤口而赐，而是为了让每一道伤口都永远铭记。

column1: Power was not given to unravel the world, but to bind its broken measures into harmony.
column2: 力量并非为拆解世界而赐，而是为了将破碎的秩序重新编织成和谐。

column1: Pressure births clarity, just as struggle shapes the soul.
column2: 压力淬出澄澈，正如磨难塑造灵魂。

column1: Prove your readiness through action. Words are easy; growth is earned.
column2: 用行动证明你已准备好。空谈容易，成长要靠自己争取。

column1: Ready a dedicated heavy weapon and swap to it mid-battle to unleash overwhelming firepower. Unlocks Gatling Guns and Launchers
column2: 准备专用重武器，并可在战斗中切换至该武器，以释放压倒性火力。解锁加特林机枪与爆破发射器。

column1: Reduced drag lets each stride answer faster than heavy armor.
column2: 降低阻力，让每一步都比身着重甲时更加迅捷。

column1: Refine your skills before you seek greater power. Advancement rewards preparation.
column2: 追求更强力量之前，先磨炼技能。充分准备者才配得上进阶。

column1: Refinement is simple: heat, pressure, materials, and lots of loud clanging.
column2: 精炼很简单：加热、施压、投入材料，再来一大堆震耳欲聋的敲打声。

column1: Rest a moment, breathe, and try not to immediately run back into danger. I know you will, but please try.
column2: 休息片刻，喘口气，尽量别马上又冲进危险里。我知道你肯定会，但还是请尽量忍住。

column1: Risk makes the reward worth swinging for.
column2: 风险越高，挥这一锤才越值得。

column1: Rupture the area with umbral force, marking enemies so they take increased damage.
column2: 以幽影力量撕裂区域，标记敌人，使其受到更多伤害。

column1: Sea's calm enough today. That is as close to a promise as sailors make.
column2: 今天海面还算平静——这已经是水手最接近保证的话了。

column1: Seen any Essence around? Bring me Essence and a piece of gear, and I can help reshape what sleeps inside it.
column2: 最近见到精华了吗？把精华和一件装备带来，我能帮你重塑其中沉睡的力量。

column1: Shards are cheap. Chunks are not. Confidence remains free.
column2: 碎片便宜，材料块可不便宜。好在自信始终免费。

column1: Shards get you started, Chunks help you push further. Crystals? Oh, no, no. Those are above my pay grade.
column2: 碎片适合入门，材料块能助你更进一步。晶体？不不不，那可不是我这个薪水档次该管的。

column1: Sharpen your battle rhythm, increasing Attack Speed and critical chance for a short time.
column2: 磨砺战斗节奏，短时间提高攻击速度与暴击率。

column1: Shatter frozen magic around the target, dealing Water damage and applying Slow.
column2: 粉碎目标周围的冻结魔法，造成水属性伤害并施加减速。

column1: Some materials whisper to me. Most just smell terrible.
column2: 有些材料会对我低语，大多数只会散发恶臭。

column1: Spectral wings crown the staff, letting elements answer faster than thought.
column2: 幽灵羽翼为法杖加冕，让元素以快过思绪的速度响应。

column1: Speed was not given for elegance, but for certainty, that the strike arrive before warning and force be felt before fear found its name.
column2: 速度并非为优雅而赐，而是为了确保攻击先于警告抵达，让力量在恐惧得名之前便被感知。

column1: Spread lingering umbral decay beneath enemies, damaging them and marking them with shadow.
column2: 在敌人脚下散布持续存在的幽影腐化，造成伤害并施加暗影标记。

column1: Stand with purpose. Advancement begins when you choose what kind of strength you are reaching for.
column2: 站稳脚步，明确目标。当你决定追求何种力量时，进阶便已开始。

column1: Steel is made righteous not by sharpness, but by the promise that governs its use.
column2: 使钢铁归于正义的并非锋利，而是约束其用途的承诺。

column1: Steel that lives does not merely endure the strike; it remembers it, returns it, and grows more terrible for having borne it.
column2: 活着的钢铁不只承受打击；它会铭记、奉还，并因经受一切而愈发可怖。

column1: Step into the mirror. Step out with better decisions.
column2: 走进镜中，再带着更明智的决定出来。

column1: Storage is much easier when you bank with the Magical Item Retrieval Association.
column2: 把东西存在魔法物品寻回协会，仓储就轻松多了。

column1: Stormreef is the first stop out there. Keep your footing, watch the waves, and we will arrive there safely.
column2: 风暴礁岛是出海后的第一站。站稳脚步、留意海浪，我们就能平安抵达。

column1: Stormreef's a fine place, if you like salt, wind, and danger with excellent scenery.
column2: 如果你喜欢盐味、海风、危险，还有绝佳风景，风暴礁岛是个好地方。

column1: Strength was not given to stand above others, but to remain when others had nowhere else to stand.
column2: 力量并非为凌驾他人而赐，而是为了在他人无处立足时依然坚守。

column1: Stronger gear starts with the right materials, and maybe a little bit of faith.
column2: 更强的装备始于合适的材料，或许还要加上一点信仰。

column1: Style is the strongest kind of magic. Let's cast some.
column2: 造型才是最强的魔法。来施展一下吧。

column1: Substats are suggestions. Perfect substats are a myth.
column2: 副属性只是参考，完美副属性只是传说。
阳光草甸 阳光草甸

column1: Swiftness was not given for escape alone, but so life might move freely where darkness sought to close its hand.
column2: 迅捷并非只为逃离而赐，更为了让生命在黑暗企图合拢手掌之处自由穿行。

column1: Swiftness was not given for mercy, but so the unseen might remain untouched while all others stumbled.
column2: 迅捷并非出于慈悲而赐，而是让无形者在众人踉跄之时仍不受触碰。

column1: Take one deep breath before the next battle. It may be the smartest thing you do today.
column2: 下一场战斗前先深呼吸一次。这或许是你今天最明智的举动。

column1: Take this Waystone. It is attuned to Nevaris, and will carry you back here when you need to return.
column2: 拿好这块传送石。它已与内瓦里斯同调，需要返回时会将你送回这里。

column1: Tempest and Chain Lightning build storm power with each use at a greater mana cost.
column2: 每次使用风暴与连锁闪电都会积累风暴力量，但会消耗更多法力。

column1: Tempest 与 Chain Lightning 会累积 Tempest Engine，提高其威力与 MP 消耗。Chain Lightning 还会触发 Thunder Storm。
column2: 风暴与连锁闪电会累积风暴引擎，提高其威力与法力消耗。连锁闪电还会触发雷暴。

column1: Tetra Vortex echoes back mana when cast.
column2: 施放元素过载时会回响并返还法力。

column1: The arena awaits. What will it be?
column2: 竞技场正等着你。要怎么选？

column1: The arena is not about monsters, treasure, or excuses. It is about skill, timing, and making your opponents regret standing against you.
column2: 竞技场不讲怪物、宝藏或借口，只看技巧、时机，以及如何让对手后悔与你为敌。

column1: The blade is made righteous not by promise, but by the end it delivers without delay.
column2: 使刀锋归于正义的并非承诺，而是它毫不迟疑带来的终结。

column1: The boat floats, the route is open, and I only worry when the sea gets too quiet.
column2: 船浮得起来，航线也畅通。我只担心大海安静得过了头。

column1: The Compass points upward. Whether that is good news depends on you.
column2: 指南针指向上方。至于是好消息还是坏消息，就看你了。

column1: The deepest arts were not given to the many, but guarded in silence until a will strong enough could draw from them without trembling.
column2: 最深奥的法术并未赐予众人，而是在沉默中受到守护，直至足够强大的意志能毫不颤抖地汲取它们。

column1: The Echoing Spire does not open for curiosity. Bring a Spire Compass, and I will reveal the path upward.
column2: 回响尖塔不会为好奇者开启。带来一枚尖塔指南针，我便为你揭示向上的道路。

column1: The enemy reinforces its guard, greatly increasing block chance for a short time.
column2: 敌人强化防御，短时间大幅提高格挡率。

column1: The enemy sharpens its focus, greatly increasing critical chance for a short time.
column2: 敌人进入专注状态，短时间大幅提高暴击率。

column1: The falling star was not summoned to revel in ruin, but to break what rot had claimed beyond healing.
column2: 陨星并非为了纵享毁灭而受召，而是为了击碎那些已被腐朽侵占、再无治愈可能之物。

column1: The forge can lift your gear to glory, or knock it down a peg.
column2: 熔炉能让你的装备一步登天，也能一锤打回原形。

column1: The glow you seek isn't mine to grant. It's the gem's choice to awaken.
column2: 你追寻的光芒并非由我赐予，是否苏醒要由宝石自己选择。

column1: The hand that cleared the briar did not conquer the earth, but invited life to follow.
column2: 清除荆棘之手并未征服大地，而是邀请生命随之而来。

column1: The hand that split the briar did not ask the earth for welcome, but carved its right to remain.
column2: 劈开荆棘之手不向大地乞求接纳，而以开拓刻下留存于此的权利。

column1: The hidden blade did not ask the world for permission, only for a moment no eye could keep.
column2: 隐刃不向世界请求许可，只等待目光无法捕捉的一瞬。
光明治愈众生，从不评判。

column1: The Magical Item Retrieval Association is a very official name for a very useful service.
column2: “魔法物品寻回协会”这个名字非常正式，提供的服务也确实非常实用。

column1: The marked were not taught to heal the wound, but to deny it a place to settle, until venom, darkness, and fear passed over them empty.
column2: 受印记者所学的不是治愈伤口，而是拒绝伤痛落脚，直至毒素、黑暗与恐惧徒然从他们身上掠过。

column1: The monster flies into a deadly rage, greatly increasing Auto Attack damage, Attack Speed, Cast Speed, and Move Speed.
column2: 怪物陷入致命狂怒，大幅提高普通攻击伤害、攻击速度、施法速度与移动速度。

column1: The shot was not loosed for pride, but for the single breath where judgment, aim, and purpose became one.
column2: 子弹并非为骄傲而发，而是为了那一息之间，判断、瞄准与使命合而为一。

column1: The spell cast cleanly, swiftly, and without excess preserved both strength and purpose, turning panic into discipline.
column2: 干净、迅捷而毫无冗余的施法，既保存力量，也守住初衷，将慌乱化为自律。
尖塔封存着失控的精通之力。

column1: The stall is neutral ground. What happens after the purchase is between you and the buyer.
column2: 摊位是中立地带。成交之后，就是你和买家之间的事了。

column1: The user rests, restoring life and mana more quickly.
column2: 使用者坐下休息，更快恢复生命与法力。

column1: The user's mana reserves and recovery deepen.
column2: 使用者的法力储备与恢复能力得到增强。

column1: The wise were not told to possess it, but to open themselves as conduits, that wonder might pass through mortal hands without being diminished.
column2: 智者受教的并非将它据为己有，而是敞开自身成为导流，使奇迹经凡人之手流过而不受减损。

column1: There are no quests posted here. There is, however, always plenty of trouble nearby.
column2: 这里没有张贴任务，不过附近从来不缺麻烦。

column1: There is no shame in beginning again with clearer purpose.
column2: 带着更明确的目标重新开始，并不可耻。

column1: These layered wraps are reinforced with rune-stitched seams and subtle card slots, favored by Weavers who walk the fine line between creation and disassembly.
column2: 这些层叠裹布以符文缝线与隐蔽卡槽加固，深受行走在创造与拆解边缘的织法师青睐。

column1: Think carefully before you bind a card. Think less carefully if you have enough coin to undo it.
column2: 绑定卡牌前要三思；金币够多的话，也可以少想一点。

column1: Think of it as reinvention, not regret. I do accept regret as a reason.
column2: 把这当成重塑自我，别说是后悔。当然，你真后悔了我也接待。

column1: This place was built to contain unstable mastery. Those who enter without an anchor rarely return as themselves.
column2: 此地为封存失控的精通之力而建。没有锚点便贸然进入者，回来时往往已不再是自己。
这座尖塔用于调节高阶力量。

column1: This wound is fresh, but will mend in time. Let me help it fade.
column2: 这是道新伤，但终会愈合。让我帮它快些消退。

column1: Thus the careful were taught to mend battle with ordered elements, shaping many paths without breaking the hand that walked them.
column2: 于是，谨慎者学会以井然有序的元素修补战局，塑造万千道路，却不伤及行路之手。

column1: Thus the chosen were taught to walk untouched where others faltered, that no affliction might claim what had been sealed against loss.
column2: 于是，受选者学会在众人失足之地安然前行，使任何苦难都无法夺走受封印守护之物。

column1: Thus the cunning were taught to brand the unseen, that thought might become poison, fear, and fate.
column2: 于是，狡黠者学会烙印无形之物，使意念化作剧毒、恐惧与命运。

column1: Thus the deathbound were taught to turn endings outward, until nova, spiral, and corpse spoke in one cold choir.
column2: 于是，受死亡束缚者学会将终结之力向外释放，直至新星、螺旋与尸骸汇成一支冰冷的合唱。

column1: Thus the devoted were taught to let power flow without pause or burden, that the wounded be sustained and the line not break.
column2: 于是，奉献者学会让力量无阻无滞地流淌，使伤者得以支撑，阵线不致崩溃。

column1: Thus the devout were taught to keep their vows in patience, that mercy might outlast terror and hope remain when strength faltered.
column2: 于是，虔信者学会耐心守诺，使慈悲比恐惧更长久，并在力量衰竭时仍存希望。

column1: Thus the elementalist was taught to cast without breaking focus, raising barriers and currents that turned force into harmony.
column2: 于是，元素法师学会在不打断专注的情况下施法，升起屏障与流能，将力量化为和谐。

column1: Thus the elusive were taught to slip between sight and consequence, that danger might grasp only emptiness and pursuit grow weary.
column2: 于是，飘忽者学会从目光与后果之间溜走，让危险只能抓住虚无，让追兵疲惫不堪。

column1: Thus the faithful were taught to heal beyond themselves, that even ruins might flower.
column2: 于是，信徒学会将治愈赐予自身之外，使废墟亦能开花。

column1: Thus the fierce were taught to strike with burning will, that each wound outlive the moment that made it and each enemy pass into scorched echo.
column2: 于是，勇猛者学会以燃烧的意志出击，使每道伤口延续得比造成它的瞬间更久，让每个敌人化作焦灼的回响。

column1: Thus the first keepers were taught to cast in reverence, that power and wisdom would rise together instead of parting ways.
column2: 于是，最初的守护者学会怀着敬畏施法，使力量与智慧一同成长，而非分道扬镳。

column1: Thus the first walkers were taught to build, that shelter, fire, and memory might endure together.
column2: 于是，最初的行者学会建造，使庇护、火种与记忆一同延续。

column1: Thus the first warborn were taught to seize, that fire, fear, and memory might answer to one will.
column2: 于是，最初的战裔学会攫取，使烈火、恐惧与记忆皆听命于同一意志。

column1: Thus the flamebound were taught to call pillar, meteor, and burst of heat where corrupted stillness needed an ending.
column2: 于是，受烈焰束缚者学会在腐化的停滞亟待终结之处，召来火柱、陨石与迸发的热浪。

column1: Thus the fleet were taught to travel lightly, that warning, aid, and hope could arrive before harm.
column2: 于是，轻捷者学会轻装疾行，让警告、援助与希望赶在伤害之前抵达。

column1: Thus the frostbound were taught to crown the field in winter, where shard and ground answered the same unmoving will.
column2: 于是，受寒霜束缚者学会为战场加冕寒冬，让冰晶与大地听命于同一股不动的意志。

column1: Thus the gifted were taught to receive and release in equal measure, that power remain living instead of still.
column2: 于是，天赋者学会等量接纳与释放，使力量保持鲜活，而非归于沉寂。

column1: Thus the hardened were taught to strike, endure, and strike again, until force itself became memory written into flesh and iron.
column2: 于是，千锤百炼者学会出击、承受、再度出击，直至力量本身化作铭刻于血肉与钢铁中的记忆。

column1: Thus the hidden were taught to strike unseen, that skill and purpose remain unbroken by mercy.
column2: 于是，潜行者学会从无形中出击，使技艺与目的不被怜悯动摇。

column1: Thus the hungry were taught to feed from ruin, that no fallen breath be squandered.
column2: 于是，饥渴者学会以毁灭为食，不让任何逝去的气息白白浪费。

column1: Thus the immovable were taught to stand as fortresses unto themselves, that every assault would break first upon their silence and feed the will within.
column2: 于是，不动者学会让自身成为堡垒，使每次攻势都先在他们的沉默前粉碎，再化作内心意志的养分。

column1: Thus the keen were taught to see truly at any range, that precision might spare effort, preserve strength, and bring order to the chaos of battle.
column2: 于是，敏锐者学会在任何距离洞见真实，以精准节省气力、保存力量，并为混乱的战场带来秩序。

column1: Thus the keepers were taught to hide what mattered most, that power might remain pure from the ruin of careless hands.
column2: 于是，守秘者学会藏起最重要之物，使力量免遭鲁莽之手玷污，始终保持纯粹。

column1: Thus the keepers were taught to master the primal not by conquest, but by accord.
column2: 于是，守护者学会不以征服，而以共鸣驾驭原初之力。

column1: Thus the knowing were taught to wield contradiction, that grace and corruption might answer the same design.
column2: 于是，洞悉者学会驾驭矛盾，使恩典与腐化皆服从同一谋划。

column1: Thus the magi were taught to trade flesh for brilliance, that mana, warding, and ruin might gather in one disciplined hand.
column2: 于是，法师们学会以血肉换取辉光，使法力、防护与毁灭汇聚于一只严守戒律的手中。

column1: Thus the patient were taught to shape the unseen, that thought might become shelter, light, and song.
column2: 于是，耐心者学会塑造无形之物，使意念化作庇护、光明与歌声。

column1: Thus the patient were taught to strike cleanly, from powder flash to far horizon, wasting neither fear nor force.
column2: 于是，耐心者学会干净利落地出击，从火药闪光直抵遥远天际，既不浪费恐惧，也不虚耗力量。

column1: Thus the relentless were taught to become momentum itself, that each blow would call the next and violence would answer before doubt returned.
column2: 于是，不屈不挠者学会化身攻势，让每一击引出下一击，在疑虑重生前便以暴力回应。

column1: Thus the ruthless were taught to take, that no strength be lost to dust or pity.
column2: 于是，无情者学会夺取，不让任何力量消散于尘土或怜悯。

column1: Thus the sanctified were taught to smite, exorcise, and call wrath only where healing alone could not restore the way.
column2: 于是，受圣化者学会只在治疗无法复原正道之处施以惩击、驱邪并召来神怒。

column1: Thus the steadfast were taught to bear the weight of battle without surrender, that courage might hold where fear sought entry.
column2: 于是，坚定者学会不屈地承受战斗之重，让勇气守住恐惧试图侵入之处。

column1: Thus the steadfast were taught to become a wall no terror could scatter, that fear, force, and sorcery alike might spend themselves in vain.
column2: 于是，坚毅者学会化作恐惧无法冲散的壁垒，任恐慌、蛮力与法术徒然耗尽。

column1: Thus the steadfast were taught to strike openly, that skill and duty remain one.
column2: 于是，坚定者学会堂堂正正地出击，使技艺与职责始终合一。

column1: Thus the stormbound were taught to drive spell after spell through the gale, until the air itself became an engine of ruin.
column2: 于是，受风暴束缚者学会在狂风中接连驱动法术，直至空气本身化作毁灭的引擎。

column1: Thus the strong were taught to endure, that the weak might rise beside them.
column2: 于是，强者学会忍耐，使弱者得以在他们身旁重新站起。

column1: Thus the swift were taught to loose death on the wind, that the unseen horizon itself would become an instrument of judgment.
column2: 于是，迅捷者学会乘风释放死亡，让不可见的地平线本身化作审判的器具。

column1: Thus the sworn were taught to bind their gifts longer than nature allowed, that devotion might outlast flesh and obligation remain unbroken.
column2: 于是，立誓者学会让天赋的维系超越自然所容，使奉献比血肉更长久，责任永不破灭。

column1: Thus the sworn were taught to cast light through steel, cross, and consecrated ground, that the helpless might stand within its reach.
column2: 于是，立誓者学会借钢铁、十字圣印与祝圣之地施放光明，让无助者能在其照耀下站立。

column1: Thus the sworn were taught to seal their will in ritual, that no weakness go unanswered and no plea remain empty.
column2: 于是，立誓者学会在仪式中封入自身意志，使每一处弱点都得到回应，每一次祈求都不落空。

column1: Thus the veiled were taught to release darkness between elemental signs, striking where pursuit had already lost its name.
column2: 于是，隐匿者学会在元素印记之间释放黑暗，于追踪早已失去意义之处出击。

column1: Thus the watchful were taught to see the shape of victory before the strike was loosed, that action would serve purpose instead of impulse.
column2: 于是，警醒者学会在攻击发出前看清胜利的形状，让行动服从目的，而非冲动。

column1: Thus the watchful were taught to turn aside the unseen, that spellcraft itself might be answered without surrendering to it.
column2: 于是，警醒者学会拨开无形之力，不向法术屈服，亦能予以回应。

column1: Thus the wise were taught to seek fullness instead of excess, that power in all its forms might serve life without tearing it apart.
column2: 于是，智者学会追求圆满而非过度，使各种形态的力量都能为生命效力，而不将其撕裂。

column1: Thus the wrathful were taught to chase the fleeing life in axe, claw, and cyclone, until battle answered only hunger.
column2: 于是，盛怒者学会以战斧、利爪与旋风追猎逃逸的生命，直至战场只回应饥渴。

column1: True warding was not vengeance, but guardianship, preserving mind, body, and spirit from the reach of powers that sought to bend them from afar.
column2: 真正的防护并非复仇，而是守望，使心智、躯体与灵魂免受远方扭曲之力的侵袭。

column1: Umbral Fragments are made of nightmares. Naturally, adventurers keep bringing me bags of them.
column2: 幽影碎片由梦魇凝成。冒险者自然会一袋接一袋地给我送来。
不受控制的攀升只会导致崩塌。

column1: Undoing bad choices is my full-time job.
column2: 替冒险者收拾错误选择，就是我的全职工作。

column1: Victory starts before the first strike.
column2: 胜负在第一次出手前就已开始。

column1: Violence and fallen enemies return life and mana to the user.
column2: 伤害敌人或将其击败时，会为使用者恢复生命与法力。

column1: Vulkanite is for weapons, Gravion is for armor, and Lunaris is for artifacts. Mix them up and the blacksmith will laugh at both of us.
column2: 火山岩用于武器，格拉维恩用于护甲，露娜里斯用于神器。要是拿混了，铁匠会把咱俩一起笑话。

column1: Vulkanite, Gravion, Lunaris. Three fancy rocks, endless bad decisions.
column2: 火山岩、格拉维恩、露娜里斯。三种漂亮石头，无数糟糕决定。

column1: Want safer upgrades? Use better materials. Want cheaper upgrades? Suphara help you, because I can only do so much.
column2: 想提高成功率？用更好的材料。想省钱？那只能求苏帕拉保佑了，我能做的就这么多。

column1: Warning: Reports of undead activity have increased in the southern region.
column2: 警告：南部地区报告的不死生物活动正在增加。

column1: Water shields the user and can answer incoming blows with Frozen.
column2: 水流保护使用者；受到攻击时，有概率冻结攻击者。

column1: Wayfarer's Landing behind us, Stormreef ahead. Simple route, rough water.
column2: 身后是旅人港，前方是风暴礁岛。航线简单，海况可不简单。

column1: We're just one hammer swing from greatness... or dust.
column2: 离巅峰只差一锤……离化为灰烬也一样。

column1: Weapons, armor, artifacts... they all scream differently under the hammer.
column2: 武器、护甲、神器……在锤下的惨叫各不相同。

column1: Welcome to Nevaris. The last bastion of hope.
column2: 欢迎来到内瓦里斯。这里是希望的最后堡垒。

column1: Welcome to the Magical Item Retrieval Association. How can I assist you today?
column2: 欢迎来到魔法物品寻回协会。今天需要什么帮助？

column1: Welcome! I'm Mira, from the Magical Item Retrieval Association. You can call me Mira; everyone does.
column2: 欢迎！我是魔法物品寻回协会的米拉。叫我米拉就好，大家都这么叫。

column1: Welcome! Would you like to access your Mira Vault today?
column2: 欢迎！今天要打开米拉仓库吗？

column1: What flesh forgot, blood remembered; what the soul loosed, will made useful again.
column2: 血液铭记肉身遗忘之事；意志则让灵魂释出的事物重获用途。

column1: What life remained was not to be hoarded, nor spent in hatred, but carried onward together.
column2: 残存的生命不应被独占，也不应耗费于仇恨，而应由众人共同延续。

column1: When battle favored the hesitant no longer, Umbra taught that force must move faster than fear can think.
column2: 当战斗不再眷顾迟疑者，翁布拉教诲世人：力量必须快过恐惧的念头。

column1: When chaos pressed against the last bastions, Vitae taught that mastery was mercy measured without waste.
column2: 当混沌逼近最后的堡垒，维泰教诲世人：精准而毫无浪费的掌控，亦是一种慈悲。

column1: When confusion clouded the field, Vitae taught the faithful to let sight become certainty.
column2: 当迷乱笼罩战场，维泰教导信徒让目光化为确信。

column1: When danger still hid beyond the edge of knowing, Vitae taught that vision must travel where the body could not.
column2: 当危险仍潜藏在认知边界之外，维泰教诲世人：目光必须抵达肉身无法前往之处。

column1: When darkness pressed against the gate, Vitae placed a shield in the Paladin's hand and a dawn behind it.
column2: 当黑暗逼近城门，维泰在圣骑士手中放下一面盾，并在盾后升起黎明。

column1: When distance turned courage into guesswork, Vitae steadied the Gunslinger's hand.
column2: 当距离让勇气沦为猜测，维泰稳住了枪手的手。

column1: When fear rose higher than prayer, Umbra taught that power need not be begged if it can be bound.
column2: 当恐惧压过祈祷，翁布拉教诲世人：既能缔结契约，便无须乞求力量。

column1: When fear rose higher than prayer, Vitae taught that faith need not thunder to endure.
column2: 当恐惧压过祈祷，维泰教诲世人：信仰无须雷鸣般高亢，亦能长存。

column1: When hostile sorcery darkened the air, Vitae raised no boast against it, but a veil through which malice could not easily pass.
column2: 当敌对法术令空气昏暗，维泰没有以夸耀抗衡，而是升起一道恶意难以穿透的帷幕。

column1: When lesser armor cracked beneath the world's cruelty, Umbra taught the strong to clothe themselves not in protection alone, but in permanence.
column2: 当脆弱的护甲在世界的残酷下崩裂，翁布拉教导强者披覆的不能只有防护，更应是恒久不灭。

column1: When lesser minds feared the heavens, Umbra taught the learned to listen when the cosmos spoke in fire.
column2: 当浅薄之人畏惧苍穹，翁布拉教导博学者聆听宇宙以烈火发出的言语。

column1: When mortal strength proved too brief for mortal need, Umbra taught that vows should not end where the body does.
column2: 当凡人之力太过短暂，无法满足凡人的需要，翁布拉教诲世人：誓言不应随肉身一同终结。

column1: When poison, shadow, and silence learned to stalk the living, Umbra answered not with cleansing, but with refusal.
column2: 当剧毒、暗影与沉默学会追猎生者，翁布拉不以净化回应，而以拒绝相抗。

column1: When scattered threads of fire, frost, thunder, and stone pulled against the loom, Vitae taught the Weaver to answer gently.
column2: 当烈焰、寒霜、雷霆与岩石的散乱丝线在织机上彼此拉扯，维泰教导织法师以柔和回应。

column1: When set into an artifact, a refined gem can sing with greater power. Please do not sing back unless invited.
column2: 精炼后的宝石镶入神器时，能唱出更强的力量。除非受到邀请，请不要跟着唱。

column1: When softer hands failed against the world's cruelty, Umbra taught that strength is not born once, but hammered into being again and again.
column2: 当软弱的双手败给世界的残酷，翁布拉教诲世人：力量并非一次诞生，而是在反复锤炼中铸就。

column1: When storms, spells, and mirrored wrath battered the faithful, Vitae shaped within them a center that would not yield.
column2: 当风暴、法术与反噬之怒摧折信徒，维泰在他们心中塑成了永不屈服的核心。

column1: When the Berserker's oath broke beneath rage, Umbra did not calm the blood, but sharpened it.
column2: 当狂战士的誓言在暴怒中破碎，翁布拉没有平息其热血，反而将它磨砺成锋。

column1: When the clash of war broke lesser spirits, Vitae tempered the faithful as iron in a living flame.
column2: 当战争的冲撞击溃脆弱的心灵，维泰将信徒置于活焰中，如钢铁般淬炼。

column1: When the dead walked in mockery and sorrow clung to the living, Vitae answered through the Priest's raised hand.
column2: 当死者亵渎般行走，悲伤纠缠生者，维泰借牧师高举的手作出回应。

column1: When the enemy believed distance meant safety, Umbra taught the storm to answer from beyond sight.
column2: 当敌人以为距离意味着安全，翁布拉教会风暴从视野之外回应。

column1: When the grave refused to keep its counsel, Umbra taught the Necromancer to listen.
column2: 当坟墓不再缄默，翁布拉教会死灵法师倾听。

column1: When the heavens burned above a world afraid to change, Vitae taught the Wizard that fire could be renewal.
column2: 当天穹在畏惧改变的世界之上燃烧，维泰教导巫师：火焰亦可带来新生。

column1: When the path vanished between flame, frost, storm, and shadow, Umbra taught the Shinobi to become the bridge.
column2: 当道路消失在烈焰、寒霜、风暴与暗影之间，翁布拉教导忍者化身桥梁。

column1: When the paths of the world grew tangled, Umbra taught the hidden to pass where no hand could close.
column2: 当世间道路纠缠不清，翁布拉教导潜行者穿过任何手掌都无法合拢之处。

column1: When the paths of the world grew tangled, Vitae sent guidance on the breath between leaves.
column2: 当世间道路纠缠不清，维泰借叶间的微风送来指引。

column1: When the river of life fled too quickly from loss, Umbra taught the Wizard to still its passing.
column2: 当生命之河因伤亡而过快流逝，翁布拉教导巫师冻结它的去路。

column1: When the sky became a machine of screaming wind, Umbra taught the Wizard to place a hand upon its turning heart.
column2: 当天空化作尖啸狂风的巨械，翁布拉教导巫师将手按在它旋转的心脏上。

column1: When the world remembered the first balance beneath every spell, Vitae taught the Wizard to stand at the center of the elements.
column2: 当世界忆起每道法术之下最初的平衡，维泰教导巫师立于元素的中心。

column1: When the wounded bent beneath the weight of dusk, Umbra gathered what the living spilled.
column2: 当伤者被暮色的重压折弯，翁布拉收集生者流失的一切。

column1: When the wounded bent beneath the weight of dusk, Vitae gave not command, but breath.
column2: 当伤者被暮色的重压折弯，维泰赐下的不是命令，而是一息生机。

column1: When wrath rose from the deep places of the world, Umbra taught that flame was truest when married to the blade.
column2: 当怒火从世界深处升腾，翁布拉教诲世人：烈焰与刀锋相合之时最为真切。

column1: Where the ground was scarred and ash remembered war, Umbra drank what lingered there.
column2: 在大地伤痕累累、灰烬仍铭记战争之处，翁布拉饮尽残留的一切。

column1: Where the ground was scarred and ash remembered war, Vitae laid down bloom.
column2: 在大地伤痕累累、灰烬仍铭记战争之处，维泰播下繁花。

column1: Wind shields the user and can answer incoming blows with Chain Lightning.
column2: 疾风保护使用者；受到攻击时，有概率对攻击者施放连锁闪电。

column1: Wisdom was not given to shield the timid, but to call down wrath with a will refined enough to survive its answer.
column2: 智慧并非为庇护怯懦者而赐，而是为了以千锤百炼的意志召下天怒，并承受它的回应。

column1: Would you like to deposit or withdraw today?
column2: 今天要存放物品，还是取出物品？

column1: Yes, every effect. Even the helpful ones. Healing is not known for being picky.
column2: 没错，所有效果，连有益效果也不例外。治疗可没有挑挑拣拣的习惯。

column1: You are now leaving the safe zone. Check your gear, your supplies, and your confidence.
column2: 你即将离开安全区。请检查装备、补给，还有自己的信心。

column1: You bring the face, I bring the flair.
column2: 你把脸带来，我负责添彩。

column1: You can queue for battle here, and if you have allies with you, I can help send you in together.
column2: 你可以在这里排队匹配；若有队友同行，我也能安排你们一同入场。

column1: You fused the wrong card, didn't you? It happens.
column2: 融合错卡牌了，对吧？常有的事。

column1: You have been disconnected for being idle
column2: 因长时间未操作，已与服务器断开连接

column1: You have disconnected from the server
You slay it, I stitch it into fashion.
column2: 你负责猎杀，我负责把它缝成时装。

column1: You're not just selling items. You're selling the dream of selling items.
column2: 你卖的不只是物品，更是把物品卖出去的梦想。

column1: You've got that look... ready for battle?
column2: 瞧你这副神情……准备好战斗了？

column1: Your face is not permanent. Your reputation might be, but we can work around it.
column2: 脸可以改，名声可能改不了，不过我们总能想办法。

column1: Your stall stays active for 48 hours, but you can release it early if you are done selling.
column2: 摊位会持续营业 48 小时；若已卖完，也可以提前结束营业。

column1: Your Waystone remembers more roads than your feet ever could.
column2: 传送石记得的道路，比你的双脚走过的还多。

column1: 以 Elemental Overload 撕开风暴，反复造成风属性伤害并使敌人眩晕。
column2: 以元素过载撕开风暴，反复造成风属性伤害并使敌人眩晕。

column1: 以 Elemental Overload 点燃战场，反复造成火属性伤害并灼烧敌人。
column2: 以元素过载点燃战场，反复造成火属性伤害并灼烧敌人。

column1: 以 Elemental Overload 粉碎地面，反复造成地伤害并大幅减速敌人。
column2: 以元素过载粉碎地面，反复造成大地属性伤害并大幅减速敌人。

column1: 以 Elemental Overload冻结战场，反复造成水伤害并将敌人定在原地。
column2: 以元素过载冻结战场，反复造成水属性伤害并将敌人定在原地。

column1: 冻结的持续时间延长。Blizzard 与 Ice Shard 可以生成 Frozen Ground。
column2: 冰封持续时间延长。暴风雪与冰霜碎片可以生成冰封大地。

column1: 凝聚专注与反应力，短时间提高 AGI 和 DEX。
column2: 凝聚专注与反应力，短时间提高敏捷与灵巧。

column1: 升起一名 Skeleton Mage，从远处使用不稳定的死灵魔法攻击。
column2: 唤起一名骷髅法师，从远处使用不稳定的死灵魔法攻击。

column1: 升起一名 Skeleton 与你并肩作战，成为不死军队的骨干。
column2: 唤起一名骷髅与你并肩作战，成为不死军队的中坚。

column1: 发射一颗命中后爆炸的火球，灼烧敌人并留下 Firewall。
column2: 发射一颗命中后爆炸的火球，灼烧敌人并留下火焰之墙。

column1: 向单个敌人发射凝聚的 Soul魔法。
column2: 向单个敌人发射凝聚的灵魂魔法。

column1: 大幅提高所有属性、移动速度与伤害减免。获得 Game Master Cloaking 和 Resurrection。
column2: 大幅提高所有属性、移动速度与伤害减免。获得管理员隐匿与复活。

column1: 如果你看得到这条信息，你要么本身就是 Game Master，要么正在查看游戏文件！
column2: 如果你看得到这条信息，你要么本身就是游戏管理员，要么正在查看游戏文件！

column1: 对于能听到它回答的人来说，埋藏的东西永远不会真正丢失。- Codex
column2: 对于能听到它回答的人来说，埋藏之物永远不会真正遗失。——翁布拉法典

column1: 对目标使出威力荒谬的一记 Bonk。有些教训只能靠钝器。
column2: 对目标使出威力惊人的一记猛敲。有些教训只能靠钝器。

column1: 引爆一个 Skeleton 召唤物，释放死灵冲击，使附近敌人与召唤物在死亡时爆炸。
column2: 引爆一个骷髅召唤物，释放死灵冲击，使附近敌人与召唤物在死亡时爆炸。

column1: 提高弓类攻击力与 DEX。
column2: 提高弓类攻击力与灵巧。

column1: 残留的死灵区域会持续伤害敌人，并传播衰败与 Desecration。
column2: 残留的死灵区域会持续伤害敌人，并传播衰败与亵渎。

column1: 灼烧或眩晕会触发 Combustion。Fire Pillar 获得更多作用次数，Meteor 则会变为 Meteor Storm。
column2: 燃烧或眩晕会触发燃爆。火柱获得更多作用次数，陨星则会变为陨星风暴。

column1: 自动攻击有概率自动施放 Strafing Volley。
column2: 普通攻击有概率自动施放扫射齐射。

column1: 进入召唤者状态，强化召唤物，使其以自身魔法回响 Soul Strike。
column2: 进入召唤者状态，强化召唤物，使其以自身魔法回响灵魂打击。

column1: 通过严谨的武器训练，Knight 的攻击变得更快、更利落。真正可怕的，是将同一招练习千次的人。
column2: 通过严谨的武器训练，骑士的攻击变得更快、更利落。真正可怕的，是将同一招练习千次的人。

column1: 释放持续更久的 War Cry，为附近盟友提供更长时间的威能。
column2: 释放持续更久的战吼，为附近盟友提供更长时间的威能。
